# phyto

> A lightweight, open-source presentation tool for worship gatherings. Build sets of songs, scripture, and media — group them into gatherings — and present them live.

## Pages

- [Create](/): Build and manage sets of songs, scripture, and media. Group them into gatherings for live presentation.
- [Present](/present): Live presentation mode for projecting lyrics, scripture, and media during worship gatherings.
- [Output](/output): Configure and display the active slide for projection.
- [About](/about): What phyto is and how it works.
- [Change Log](/change-log): Release history and updates.
- [Feedback](/feedback): Submit feedback, report bugs, or request features.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How user data is collected, stored, and used.
- [Terms of Use](/terms): Terms and conditions for using phyto.

## Optional

- [phyto on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/phyto.live): Follow for updates and community content.
- [Support phyto on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/valiantchan): Donate to support ongoing development.
